question: Is direction D004 already explored or contradicted: Keep the D003 evaluation design and reframe the contribution as implementation-and-measurement rather than problem identification: enforce valid-time membership at retrieval time (post hoc, across BM25/dense/hybrid), and measure clause-level point-in-time recovery and version contamination, with answer accuracy co-primary only on answer-differential queries. Present the benchmark as filling the named clause-granularity gap, not as discovering it, and present valid-time gating as the correct signal to enforce at retrieval time rather than as a new concept.?
rationale: A refined direction must be checked against existing work before it is recommended.
